# LTC Tops 2026 Mid-Point SHOP Acquisition Guidance with $62 Million Transaction; Welcomes Grace Management to SHOP Platform


November 03, 2026 9:15 am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.ltcreit.com/_assets/_6b013f9e9cb3a8f0914a43dc6b378a10/ltcreit/news/2026-11-03_LTC_Tops_2026_Mid_Point_SHOP_Acquisition_Guidance__478.pdf)


*-- SHOP Acquisitions Year-To-Date Reach Nearly $950 Million --*


WESTLAKE VILLAGE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **LTC Properties, Inc. (NYSE: LTC)** (“LTC” or the “Company”), a real estate investment trust specializing in seniors housing and health care properties, today announced the $62 million acquisition of a community in its seniors housing operating portfolio (“SHOP”), surpassing its $900 million 2026 mid-point acquisition guidance and adding a new SHOP operator.


**Acquisition Highlights:**


- $62 million acquisition; 117-unit assisted living and memory care community in Florida; built in 2016.
- Grace Management, Inc. (“Grace”) a tenured operator new to LTC, will continue to manage the community.
- Expected year-one cap rate of 6.5%; anticipated unlevered IRR in the low- to mid-teens.


**Funding:** Proceeds from the Company’s revolving line of credit and ATM sales.


**SHOP Highlights:**


- 50 communities with an average age of nine years; managed by 14 operators, including 12 new relationships.
- 60% of portfolio located in primary markets as designated by NIC.
- Contributing 45% of the Company's pro forma annualized net operating income (“NOI”).
- Year-to-date, LTC has completed nearly $950 million in SHOP acquisitions, surpassing its $900 million mid-point 2026 investment guidance.


“Surpassing the mid-point of our 2026 acquisition guidance reflects the strength of our SHOP strategy, the relationships we have built, and our team’s solid execution,” said Dave Boitano, LTC’s Chief Investment Officer. “We remain excited about our momentum and the opportunities ahead to further scale and diversify our SHOP platform. Grace is a great addition to our portfolio, and we look forward to growing with them.”


**About LTC**


LTC is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on seniors housing and health care properties, principally investing through SHOP, as well as triple-net leases, and joint ventures. The Company’s portfolio includes nearly 170 properties throughout the United States. Based on gross real estate investments, 80% of the Company’s assets are seniors housing communities with the remainder skilled nursing centers.
